text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! Put your backs into it 
and pull that float with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, SEI!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Mgogogogogo...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she won't budge an inch. Man, I'm at 
my wit's end here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the autumn festival, the 
"Shundai Festival." Tamamo Cross and Inari 
One were leading the mikoshi float, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's heavier than I thought... Heavy tank 
class—would that be the term?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan, don't look so down in the dumps. 
In short, what you're missing is..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's do this with guts!!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec, Inari. When we're this 
disorganized, sheer spirit isn't gonna cut 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's got their own reason for not 
being in sync. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I gotta talk to each of 'em properly. Just 
like reasoning with the little ones.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan, what's wrong? What're ya 
hesitating for?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, um... I felt like I had to match 
everyone else's rhythm, so I ended up just 
watching.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer overthinkin' it. If ya do that, yer 
bound to be a beat too slow, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just do it the way you want to! Don't 
worry, trust the people around you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-san. For me, it's quite the 
opposite; I just can't help getting ahead 
of myself...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Yaeno does martial arts, right? That's 
why she gets overly focused.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to dart off like a flash 
of lightning. Take a breather and take it 
easy, alright?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, I...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You are—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Once we're done, I'll treat ya to a meal!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Got it! Yeah, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right! This time for sure, I'm gonna 
nail it perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, SEI!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, we did it, Tama! Now this is what I 
call brute strength in a pinch!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, see, told ya, didn't I? First thing 
is to lend 'em a hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tamamo Cross's meticulous 
leadership, the portable shrine was able 
to parade around freely.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer. How should we haul this 
mikoshi around? Have fun with it, or go 
all wild and rough!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a special festival, after all. In 
order to get everyone as hyped up as 
possible—
choice_data_list: Having fun together with the kids.
A super flashy portable shrine battle!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Together with the kids?! Right on, might 
as well let the little ones join in too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Come on over! We'll show ya how 
to pull the mikoshi portable shrine!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it. Put more power into your 
core...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Breathing is crucial. Imagine yourself 
becoming one with the mikoshi shrine...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're not supposed to pull on my hair, 
okay? Please focus properly on the 
portable shrine, okay?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh, your place is behind the local 
shrine? Not bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Trainer. After all, getting hyped 
up together like this really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll send some photos to the little ones 
back in Osaka too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Inari. Bring everyone and get over 
here!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A heartwarming time spent with children. 
Tamamo Cross learned that festivals aren't 
just about making a big fuss.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, a mikoshi battle! That sounds so 
hype, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, everyone! Let's go see which 
portable shrine is the fastest and 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do this thing!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, Tama, that's quite a change from 
how gently you were teaching just a moment 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course it is. The whole point of teachin' 
you properly was so we could unite and win 
together when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to show 'em that Naniwa 
guts! Danjiri, babyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't... a danjiri festival. But 
Tamamo Cross went wild and put on a show 
at the autumn festival.
